q2_gaps: Narrative past perfect whose reference event sits in a NEIGHBOURING sentence ("The three sky-cats had molted", "Feathers had fallen" preceding "Tessa Brae collected forty-one feathers"): the Time section's ordering test is stated per-sentence ("emit the ordering whenever the sentence contains another asserted event for the perfect to precede") while its exclusion is stated per-text ("no other event in the text"), so passage-level anteriority has neither a stated trigger nor a rule for choosing which later event to order against.
notes: The bare-plural group "Feathers had fallen" (idx 27-31) gets no per-member distribution rule even though the counted plurals in sentences 2 and 3 do; the instruction set mandates the rule for counted/definite plurals but says only "mints a group witness" for a bare-plural episodic subject, so this reads as an instruction-set ambiguity rather than a parse defect. "a Watch ledger" is fused as watch_ledger with genus ledger, which is consistent with the parse's own licensed reading of "the Watch" as a capitalized common noun (no Name atom) rather than a proper-noun premodifier taking Possession.
